cell: Property layout (second opinion on the design record)
statement: Two shapes coexist for a pure-component law: vapour pressure and heat capacities are per-component law objects built from the record's own model word (Component.cpp:543, :780-790); liquid viscosity, conductivity and surface tension are per-package models that read a sub-block of their own name in every record (LiquidViscosityModel.H:88).  The second shape is why one word cannot price components whose records hold different forms; the target of the layout should be the first shape for all, with the package word as the mixing rule only.

cell: Property layout (second opinion on the design record)
statement: The design record postpones heat-capacity tables; the interface a table needs already exists (HeatCapacityModel.H:58-66: Cp, H, S pure virtual) and a table implementing it with its two integrals built at construction yields every enthalpy, entropy and Gibbs energy with no other change, as the ancestor's tabulated heat-capacity law does.

cell: Property layout (second opinion on the design record)
statement: No page states, per phase, which data of a record are primitive, which derived and which a redundant check (the table of section 9.4); the design record proposes one such check (a tabulated vapour pressure against the latent heat) and not the rule.
